tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.1: A blade of black slime brimming with magical power.
message.draxatomic.no_power: Not enough magical power: you need %s.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.whip: Right-click: the blade stretches and strikes everything in a line.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.dash: Right-click: dash forward, cutting through everything in your path.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.blad: Right-click where you look: slime needles rain down.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.atom: Hold right-click to charge the atomic blast.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_boots: No fall damage. Jump mid-air for a double jump (5 power).
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_suit.piece: +%s max magical power and +1 regen per second.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_suit.set: Full set: double regen; while sneaking, distant monsters lose your trail.
tooltip.draxatomic.shadow_emblem.help: Right-click the ground to summon her. Right-click her: follow / stay.
message.draxatomic.ally_fell: %s has fallen. Her emblem lies on the ground.
message.draxatomic.seal_day: The seal only answers at night.
tooltip.draxatomic.diablos_seal: Right-click the ground at night to summon a Knight of the Round Table.
tooltip.draxatomic.diablos_heart: Use it to gain +%s max magical power permanently.
message.draxatomic.knight_arrives: A Knight of the Round Table of the Cult of Diablos has arrived.
message.draxatomic.knight_awakens: "You think that is enough?" The knight awakens his true power.
message.draxatomic.knight_defeated: The Knight of the Round Table has fallen.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.all_: Hold right-click: mark every nearby enemy and drop an Atomic on each one.
tooltip.draxatomic.slime_sword.help.reco: Hold right-click: a sphere of light fully heals you and your allies.
tooltip.draxatomic.mitsugoshi_chocolate: Speed II and regeneration. A favorite of the nobility.
tooltip.draxatomic.mitsugoshi_coffee: Haste II and night vision for 2 minutes.
tooltip.draxatomic.mitsugoshi_shampoo: Clears negative effects and grants luck. Shine guaranteed.
